audit.whatIsWrong: The chart cannot be settled from the data I have: this packet reads Skill, Skill, Swain, Skill, Swain, Swain, Skill, the page reads Swain, Swain, Swain, Skill, Swain, Skill, Swain, and the mirror reports flipping its rows 1-5 to Illaoi against a 55.99% Illaoi win rate.
audit.why: All three disagree, and this packet's own 49.06% Swain win rate is closer to the mirror's picture than to a chart giving Swain five stages. Guessing a row here would either fight the mirror or ship a chart that contradicts the win rate, so I left every row alone and raised it as a question rather than inventing a resolution.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level 6 spike tells you to press R the instant she ults.
audit.why: Leap of Faith carries the untargetable flag — spending a 120-second ultimate into the moment she cannot be touched wastes both the cast and the drain, because the form only continues while it has a champion to drain.
audit.corrected: Level 6 reframed: let the ult resolve, then drain the tentacle barrage that follows.

audit.whatIsWrong: Illaoi's ultimate is called 'Kraken Slam' in four places. She also 'has no dash to escape the root', and tentacle placement is credited to Leap of Faith at levels 4-5.
audit.why: Her R is Leap of Faith; Kraken Slam is not an ability she has, and the packet's suspectNames missed it entirely while flagging three correct names as suspicious. Harsh Lesson is a leap to a target on a 4-second cooldown, so she absolutely has a dash — the shortest one in the lane. And tentacles spawn from Prophet of an Elder God on nearby impassible terrain; Leap of Faith only adds one per champion it hits, and it does not exist at levels 4-5 anyway.
audit.corrected: Real name used throughout, Harsh Lesson named as her 4-second leap, tentacle spawning credited to the passive and the terrain it needs.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing says the tentacle field is anchored to walls, or that you have no dash out of it.
audit.why: Tentacles only grow on impassible terrain, which is why hugging your own wall is what puts you in the field, and Swain has no dash to leave through it — Flash is the wall answer, not a damage answer.

edits.before: Your W-into-E combo lands in open lane at Level 3 and she has no dash to escape the root; pull her away from tentacles, Q the burst, collect the fragment.
edits.after: Your W-into-E lands in open lane at Level 3, but Harsh Lesson leaps to a target every 4 seconds — root her only where no tentacle can answer the pull.

edits.before: She is building tentacle density and her Leap of Faith starts to cover your usual standing spots — commit E only when the root lands clearly away from any tentacle.
edits.after: Tentacles keep growing off her passive on the walls beside your usual standing spots — commit E only when the root lands clearly away from every one of them.

edits.before: Demonic Ascension absorbs her Kraken Slam burst during her ult window instead of forcing a retreat; drain through the slam barrage and trade fragments for her ult cooldown.
edits.after: Leap of Faith makes her untargetable as it lands, so do not spend R into the cast — wait the window out, then drain her through the tentacle barrage that follows it.

edits.before: Demonic Ascension answers her ult — activate R the instant she casts Kraken Slam and drain through the tentacle barrage rather than retreating.
edits.after: Leap of Faith is her ult and she is untargetable through it — do not press R on the cast; let it land, then drain the tentacle barrage that follows.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 are a careful chess match: she accumulates tentacles and they begin to cover more of the lane, shrinking your safe space. Use W to zone her off the wave and chip her HP, but do not commit E unless you are certain the root lands in clean open space — an E that pulls her onto three tentacles turns your setup into her setup. At Level 6 the dynamic shifts clearly in your favor: when she pops Kraken Slam and all those tentacles slam simultaneously, that is exactly when you hit R. Demonic Ascension's healing absorbs the burst damage that would otherwise force you off the lane, and your drain builds Soul Fragments through her ult window rather than retreating from it. After her ult cooldown she is immobile and you are swollen with fragments — that is when you walk forward and run the full E-root-pull-Q pattern.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 are a careful chess match: tentacles keep growing on the walls, and every one of them shrinks your safe space. Note where they anchor — they only spawn on impassible terrain, so walking the wall side of the lane is what puts you in her field, and you have no dash to leave it. Zone with W, but commit E only when the root lands in clean open space; an E that pulls her onto three tentacles turns your setup into hers. At Level 6, resist the obvious play: Leap of Faith turns her untargetable as it lands, so pressing R on the cast buys nothing and the form has no one to drain. Let the ult resolve, survive the first barrage, then R and drain — she is immobile afterwards, and that is when the full root-pull-Q pattern runs.

edits.before: Land Test of Spirit to rip your spirit out and let you fight your own tentacles while she smashes you with Kraken Slam
edits.after: Land Test of Spirit to rip your spirit out so you fight your own tentacles while Harsh Lesson resets her autos on you

edits.before: Place tentacles with Leap of Faith near your normal positioning so every skirmish is fought inside her field
edits.after: Grow tentacles off her passive on the walls beside your lane positions so every skirmish happens inside her field

notes: 'Kraken Slam' is a fabricated ability name and it appeared four times, including in the level 6 spike the whole page is built around — her ultimate is Leap of Faith. The packet's suspectNames flagged three CORRECT names (Test of Spirit twice, Demonic Ascension) and missed the one real invention, which is worth knowing about that detector. Two other real errors: the page says she has no dash, when Harsh Lesson is a leap to target on a 4-second cooldown, and it credits tentacle placement at levels 4-5 to an ultimate she does not have yet — tentacles come from the passive and only on impassible terrain. Finally the level 6 advice was actively bad: Leap of Faith is untargetable, so pressing a 120-second R into the cast drains nothing. Chart NOT touched — this packet, the page, and the mirror give three different answers and I would be guessing; see questionsForUser.
